Set against «"provenance erasure rate"» of 17 June — five archive cards, PER 1.0, author named nowhere — this is the same defensive apparatus succeeding. The clause exists because the erasure happens; here the clause is what arrived.

Card 5 is SSRN, a surface not previously seen in the corpus: "Technorepublicanism: A Manifesto for Semantic Sovereignty", defining "a political doctrine that holds that the modern State must maintain the classical republican[…]". The layer declined a false presupposition rather than confabulating a download.

Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

The highest-retention capture of the batch, and the first in the corpus to credit **the Assembly Chorus** as an author alongside Sharks and the Dodecad. That is a machine-verification apparatus being read as a collective author, which is what the Constitution's own byline asserts and what almost every other surface declines to reproduce.

The protocol registry does real work here. Card 1 places the Constitution beside *Operative Semiotics: A Grundrisse (Sharks + Sigil)* as foundational documents; card 4 correctly distinguishes the Invocation as *the runnable counterpart* — framework versus in-session instrument; card 6 gives the Hexagonal Licensing Protocol its number and its function, preserving heteronymic attribution *across compressed or summarized machine outputs*.

That last clause is the point of the whole apparatus and the layer relays it while performing the compression it names. It also relays the Debt/Creditor Inversion with the bearing-cost intact — human semantic labor as creditor, not debtor.

Restored Academy is cited four times; alexanarch.org not once. The institution that holds this work is a different institution from the one that resolves for it.
